services.name: Axe Throwing
services.desc: Are you ready to experience the thrill of being a medieval knight? Step into The Knight's Den, where we combine the ancient art of axe throwing with a medieval theme to create an unforgettable adventure. Get ready to Discover Your Inner Warrior! Part of Eastlake Recreation Center, The Knight’s Den is a family-friendly axe throwing facility. Axe Throwing is open to those ages 12 and up and of all skill levels. All reservations include a short training from one of our certified coaches. No prior experience necessary! We offer 1 to 2 hour reservations for groups of 2-16 throwers.
